summary:
Form only: plan.md is written, nothing is built yet. Buff limestone masses follow the lidar setbacks (31-storey slab with a crown, a broad flat Music Hall deck with a raised stage house, an 18-storey east end). Continuous piers frame dark window strips, and every flat roof is lit.
It reads as Radio City from the street frontage: a 4-tall marquee wraps the Sixth Ave/50th St corner in a red neon line, alternating RADIO CITY / MUSIC HALL letters, a blue neon line and gold bulbs. A 22-tall blue-and-silver blade sign with stacked red RADIO CITY letters rises from the marquee at the corner; three enamel roundels sit above the 50th St run.
Planned departures from the brief: the lidar's 2-wide strip along Sixth Ave becomes the marquee zone, and the plot 1 frontage wall above the marquee stands 2-3 blocks back from the lot line. Rockefeller block in site orientation: buff-limestone Deco masses with pier/dark-strip facades and flat parapeted setback roofs. The red/blue neon marquee wraps the SW corner and runs on along the Music Hall. The RADIO CITY blade rises at the corner, and roundels sit over the 50th St marquee.

rooms.name: Corner lobby
rooms.purpose: Lit grand-entrance lobby of the Music Hall corner block, seen through the glazing: shroomlight ceiling, polished granite floor, a few banquette and pilaster pieces, warm and gold.
rooms.ways_in: glazed doors x3..9 at z50, y1..4 (south, from the 50th St sidewalk); west doors x3 z42..51

rooms.name: Sixth Avenue lobby
rooms.purpose: Shallow lit shop and lobby strip behind the west glazing, bays of 3 between piers; each bay a lit shop window with a counter.
rooms.ways_in: glazed bays at x3, z6..41 in bays of 3, y1..4

rooms.name: Music Hall foyer
rooms.purpose: Shallow lit foyer behind the 50th St doors under the marquee: shroomlight ceiling, floor of polished granite, a row of ticket kiosks.
rooms.ways_in: glass doors z49, x42..83 in pairs every 4, y1..4 (y2..4 east of x58)

rooms.name: Plaza lobby
rooms.purpose: Three-storey lit lobby of the east tower facing Rockefeller Plaza: tall glass, lit ceiling, a reception desk and a mural wall.
rooms.ways_in: glazed Plaza front x150, z18..35, y2..11

parts.name: Plot 0 tower shell
parts.scope: Plot 0 masses P0-A..H from plan.md with limestone_mass, pier_wall (phase 11), frieze_band, string course y28, setback_deck decks 20..111, crown_lantern and mast. Leaves marquee, blade, roundel and opening volumes empty.

parts.name: Music Hall shell
parts.scope: Plot 1 (x38..100) masses H-A..H-E, G; limestone_mass, piers every 4, hall_deck y31 with skylight_strip x3 and vent_box x6, stage house y33 with vent row, cut_sandstone frieze y23; leaves marquee, roundel and opening volumes.

parts.name: East end shell
parts.scope: Plot 2 (x105..155) masses E-A..I with pier_wall (phase 8), frieze_band, setback_deck decks 18/44/51/54/62/66, light well, penthouse vent_box, garden_bed on decks y18 and y44.

parts.name: Marquees
parts.scope: All marquee runs (plot 0 west, south, corner; plot 1 south) with marquee_run, marquee_corner, marquee_end, and the words via marquee_word per the placement table.

parts.name: Blade, roundels, glazing
parts.scope: blade_sign at x0..4 z51..53; roundel x5 and the plot 0 plaques; tall_window set; glazed_front and shopfront_bay for all OPENINGS (grand entrance, Sixth Ave, 50th, 51st, Plaza lobby); stage_door.

parts.name: Lights and grounds
parts.scope: lit_window_cluster (about 25%, never a full face), roof_lights, floodlight at setback feet, sidewalk with kerb, service court, alley, light well, lamp_stub every 8 along streets.

recruit.why: Limestone masses, piers, friezes, string courses and plinths
Marquee bands, letters and the vertical blade sign
Shopfronts, lobbies, tall bronze-framed windows, stage door
Roof lights, floodlights, lit windows and lamps so no mob spawns and the dusk reads
